summary: The Fed held at 3.75-4% in a 10-2 vote with Cook and Hammack wanting a hike; US stocks closed modestly higher and Alphabet reportedly slipped after hours. With BOJ on Friday and overnight price data thin, the desk is neutral across the board.
events_next_24h: Fri 7:00am USD Amazon and Intel earnings (Forex Factory feed unavailable this run; list from desk calendar only)

US jobs report (October, expected date) · Sat, 7 Nov, 12:30am

ES.risk: Clear big-tech earnings move or a yield break after the hawkish hold.

NQ.why: Alphabet reportedly fell after hours and VXN is mid-range; with Amazon earnings due tomorrow the tech picture is mixed.
NQ.risk: Decisive Microsoft/Alphabet follow-through in cash trade.

YM.risk: Hawkish repricing of December hike odds.

RTY.risk: Yields rising sharply on December hike talk would tilt bearish.
